versions.changelog:
Initial release of verified-agent-identity skill for decentralized agent identity management.

- Enables AI agents to create Ethereum-based decentralized identities on the Billions Network.
- Provides scripts to link agent DIDs to human owners using Billions ERC-8004 and Attestation Registries.
- Supports key identity operations: creation, listing, challenge generation/signing, linking, and verification.
- Stores all identity data securely in $HOME/.openclaw/billions, with strict usage and security guardrails.
- Includes detailed usage instructions and example authentication/verification flows.
